item.title: FAQ
item.description:
General

What Java version does JCAL require?

JCAL is compiled with --release 16, so it requires Java 16 or later.

Is JCAL available on Maven Central?

Not yet. JCAL is currently published on the GitHub Maven Registry. See Getting Started for installation instructions.

Can I use JCAL in a commercial project?

JCAL is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which does not permit commercial use. Please review the license terms before integrating JCAL into a commercial product.
